summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (11.52% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via single ToSTNeT-3 block trade at ¥973/share, totalling ¥973M. Execution window 2026-08-21 at 08:45 JST. Results to be disclosed same day post-trade. Note: major shareholder Sega Sammy Holdings indicated plan to sell all holdings.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares via off-auction purchase (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-20, Papyless Co. announced a single-block treasury share acquisition under ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading at the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The board had authorized on 2026-07-15 a buyback program of up to 1,000,000 shares (11.52% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for up to ¥1,100M over the period 2026-07-16 to 2026-09-30, using market purchases including ToSTNeT-3. This block trade executes a portion of that mandate: the company will place a buy order on 2026-08-21 at 08:45 JST at the previous day's closing price of ¥973/share, capped at ¥973M and 1,000,000 shares. Results will be disclosed immediately after the 08:45 window closes. The purchase is stated as supporting dynamic capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. Significantly, the company disclosed that Sega Sammy Holdings, a major shareholder, has notified of its plan to sell all shares held, which may result in a change of principal shareholders.
